## About
LaFitte HVAC is a family owned and operated heating and air conditioning company based in Conroe. We serve homeowners and businesses throughout Montgomery County and the surrounding areas.
We try to treat every customer like part of the family. That means showing up on time, explaining what we find, and fixing what needs fixing without pushing you into a whole new system.
Our customers have rated us 4.9 on Google across 300 reviews.

## Services
- Heating and air conditioning repair: We work to get your system running properly again, and to keep it running efficiently and reliably after we leave.
- Air conditioning and heating installation: New system design and installation, plus equipment upgrades, for homes and commercial buildings.
- Preventative maintenance agreement: Join our Preventative Maintenance Agreement program to help your HVAC system run efficiently and save money over time.
- Commercial HVAC: Dependable service to keep employees, customers or tenants comfortable, with energy efficient systems that can help bring energy costs down.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Request a quote online by filling out the form with a little about what you need, and our team will get in touch with you. You can also call or email us.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes, we offer financing options. A reviewer said they were offered financing through Synchrony to pay for a repair.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We work with homeowners and businesses throughout Montgomery County and the surrounding areas, from our shop in Conroe.
